races.name: Aspire Cleaning & Facilities Ltd Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Westport
runners_data.note: Two recent wins in similar conditions with prominent running style perfectly suited to controlling this small field from the front.

runners_data.name: Sanny Doo
runners_data.note: Hold-up style disadvantaged by small field but highest official rating suggests class advantage if pace collapses.

runners_data.name: You Mystify Me
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with improvement potential but unknown style creates tactical uncertainty in this limited field.

runners_data.name: Supremissy
runners_data.note: Prominent style could track Westport but concerning finishing pattern and 45-day absence create significant doubts.

races.paceDynamic: Westport will dictate terms from the front with his prominent style, setting a comfortable gallop on this sharp 5f track. With only four runners and Sanny Doo preferring to hold up, there's minimal early pressure on Westport who can control fractions. You Mystify Me and Supremissy may track closer but neither has shown the early pace to challenge Westport's position. This controlled tempo scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy in the early stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Westport Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Westport gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent winning form
scenarios.body: His two recent victories show he's effective when allowed to dictate, and with minimal early pressure he can kick clear in the straight. The lack of genuine pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too sedate and Sanny Doo can unleash his finishing kick
scenarios.body: Despite his hold-up style being disadvantaged by the small field, his higher official rating of 120 suggests superior ability if getting the right race setup. A dawdling pace would suit his patient tactics perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improving Newcomer Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If You Mystify Me builds on his promising debut third and benefits from the step up in trip
scenarios.body: His lightly raced profile offers potential for improvement, and the good going suits his previous run. The small field dynamics could help him secure a good early position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Supremissy Finds Redemption
scenarios.trigger: If Supremissy can overcome his recent poor form and his finishing concerns don't materialize
scenarios.body: His prominent style could theoretically keep him in touch with Westport early. However, his fading tendency and long absence make this unlikely against this field.

watchPoints.text: Westport's early positioning is crucial - if he doesn't establish his usual prominent spot, his entire race plan collapses
Sanny Doo needs pace development in the middle stages to set up his hold-up style in this small field
You Mystify Me's tactical approach will reveal future potential given his lightly raced status
Supremissy's ability to sustain effort in the final furlong after recent fading tendency
Overall pace development critical with only four runners and potential for crawling early fractions

races.name: Heineken Buttonhook Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Square Necker
runners_data.note: Uncontested leader with tactical advantage but needs to prove his stamina after 72 days off and stepping up in trip

runners_data.name: Elysian Flame
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with highest TopSpeed figure (85) and solid recent form, though 10-year-old faces younger rivals

runners_data.name: Galyx
runners_data.note: Returns after 312 days off which is a major concern despite his prominent style suiting the pace scenario

runners_data.name: Humble Spark
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage with 5lb claiming jockey Lauren Young taking valuable weight off

runners_data.name: Baileys Khelstar
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but recent inconsistent form and low TopSpeed (50) raises questions about ability level

runners_data.name: Mountain Road
runners_data.note: Recent winner but hold-up style makes task difficult against uncontested leader, though Jim Goldie stable in form

races.paceDynamic: Square Necker will control the front end uncontested as the sole confirmed leader, setting a measured tempo over this extended trip. Elysian Flame, Galyx and Baileys Khelstar will sit in prominent positions behind the leader, while Mountain Road and Humble Spark drop in last as hold-up horses. With no pace pressure on Square Necker, this creates a tactical advantage for the leader and prominent racers who can track into the race, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of making up significant ground. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Square Necker maintains his easy lead without pressure
scenarios.body: The leader sets his own fractions and kicks clear when asked, with the prominent horses unable to reel him in from their tracking positions. His recent winning form and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses close strongly in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: Elysian Flame or Galyx use their higher ratings to overwhelm Square Necker late, benefiting from tracking the pace without having to do the donkey work. The front-runner weakens after setting the fractions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and collapses completely
scenarios.body: Mountain Road or Humble Spark get the perfect setup with a crawling pace, allowing them to unleash their finishing kicks from the back. Their hold-up style suddenly becomes an asset rather than a hindrance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Benefits Mid-Division
scenarios.trigger: If Square Necker goes too fast trying to dominate
scenarios.body: Baileys Khelstar finds the perfect trip sitting just off the pace, avoiding both the leader's tactical disadvantage and the hold-up horses' ground-making task. His recent second suggests he's in form to capitalize.

watchPoints.text: Square Necker if he shows any signs of rustiness early after his 72-day break, which could compromise his tactical advantage
Galyx for market support given his 312-day absence - any confidence suggests connections expect him ready despite the layoff
The pace through the early stages - if Square Necker goes too fast it opens the door for the hold-up horses
Mountain Road's jumping from the stalls as his hold-up style requires a clean start to avoid being further back than ideal
Elysian Flame's position turning for home as she needs to be close enough to use her superior speed figures

races.name: Darley Stallions EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Conclave
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner stepping up in trip but brings solid recent form and the services of champion jockey McDonald.

runners_data.name: Ervani
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should get an ideal tow behind the expected pace battle, though needs to find improvement on RPR figures.

runners_data.name: Haayimm
runners_data.note: Recent winner with good tactical speed who can benefit from the anticipated strong gallop, though softer ground preferred.

runners_data.name: Proud Nation
runners_data.note: Returns after a long absence but has proven course-and-distance form that gives him a realistic chance if fit enough.

races.paceDynamic: Conclave and Proud Nation will ensure a genuine gallop from the off, with both having natural pace and leading tendencies. The early pace battle between these two should create an honest tempo that will test stamina over this 1m½f trip. With only four runners, the pace is unlikely to be destructive but will be solid enough to set up the race properly. This race shape favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and have a sustained kick, as the leaders may weaken in the final furlong after their early duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Conclave and Proud Nation engage in a prolonged speed battle through the early stages
scenarios.body: The two leaders will compromise each other's finishing efforts, allowing the prominent racers to pick up the pieces late. Ervani and Haayimm can both travel kindly behind the pace and have the class to capitalize when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Conclave Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Conclave can dictate a more measured pace and avoid a fierce early battle with Proud Nation
scenarios.body: The class horse can use his superior rating and recent form to control proceedings and kick clear when it matters. His stamina at this trip after two runs at a mile looks solid.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Proud Nation Fresh Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If Proud Nation's 238-day break has recharged his batteries and he can outlast Conclave in the pace battle
scenarios.body: His previous course-and-distance form gives him a tactical edge, and the long rest could see him maintain his gallop longer than expected. The fresh legs tell in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is surprisingly modest with both leaders showing restraint
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical and suits horses who can quicken off a slower tempo. Haayimm's recent win and tactical speed could prove decisive in a sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Conclave to settle better than expected early - if he can avoid a speed duel he becomes very dangerous with his class advantage.
Monitor Proud Nation's early enthusiasm - if he looks ring-rusty or keen after his long break, his chances diminish significantly.
Check Haayimm's position turning for home - needs to be within striking distance to utilize his proven finishing kick.
Observe Ervani's ability to handle the likely strong pace - may struggle if the gallop becomes too honest for his current level.
Watch the early fractions between the two leaders - a fierce battle will open the door for the prominent runners to strike late.

runners_data.name: Native Instinct
runners_data.note: Only confirmed pace-setter returning from 187-day break, but Edward Bethell's string suggests he'll be ready to control the tempo

runners_data.name: Starliner
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer returning from Southwell all-weather, may struggle to adapt to the tactical demands of this race shape

runners_data.name: Polygram
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with headgear applied, quick return suggests readiness but running style profile doesn't suit the likely pace scenario

runners_data.name: Arkenstaar
runners_data.note: Strong recent form with multiple wins, hold-up style suits but needs luck from the back in a race lacking early pace

runners_data.name: Native Honey
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with Jim Goldie stable in good form, quick return from recent run suggests confidence but needs clear passage

runners_data.name: Izzari
runners_data.note: Recent winner at Hamilton with proven hold-up style, faces similar traffic concerns as other closers but has course experience

runners_data.name: Quiet Resolve
runners_data.note: Long absence of 227 days raises fitness concerns despite hold-up style, trainer's poor recent record adds to doubts

races.paceDynamic: Native Instinct will take this field along as the only confirmed front runner, likely getting an uncontested lead in the early stages. With seven hold-up horses behind him, the pace will be sustainable rather than frantic, allowing Native Instinct to dictate terms without pressure. The large contingent of hold-up runners will bunch up behind, creating a cavalry charge finish where positioning and traffic navigation become crucial. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setter Native Instinct who can control the tempo, while the hold-up horses face a traffic nightmare in the sprint home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Native Instinct gets an easy lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: The front runner controls a moderate pace and has enough left to repel late challenges from the packed field behind. With seven hold-up horses creating interference for each other, the leader's clear run proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the closers gets a clear passage through the inevitable traffic
scenarios.body: A single hold-up runner manages to navigate around the congestion and arrives with a sustained finish to collar the tiring leader. The winner needs both class and a clean passage to succeed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Native Instinct gets pressured early by one of the prominent types
scenarios.body: The increased early pace leaves Native Instinct vulnerable, opening the door for a horse that can quicken from mid-division. This scenario requires someone to force the pace harder than expected.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Completely Open Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a slow-run affair
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where any horse with tactical speed can win regardless of typical running style. Form and class become the primary factors rather than pace positioning.

watchPoints.text: Native Instinct's ability to handle the step up in trip after 187 days off, as stamina concerns could hand the race to the closers
The start positioning of the seven hold-up horses, as early crowding will determine which closers get clear runs in the finish
Arkenstaar's jumping from the gates given his recent winning form, as any early prominence would disrupt the expected pace scenario
Polygram's response to the headgear change, as improved alertness could help him overcome his unfavourable running style
The pace through the first half-mile, as any deviation from steady fractions will reshape the entire tactical picture

races.paceDynamic: With Glory will lead from the gates with Cosmic Clarets, Simba's Pride and Breeze Star settling prominently behind. The pace will be controlled and sustainable as With Glory faces no genuine pace pressure from fellow front-runners. The lack of early speed duel allows the tempo to build gradually, creating a finishing kick scenario in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late speed, as the controlled early pace will set up perfectly for closers to unleash their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Kick
scenarios.trigger: If With Glory leads unchallenged through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The measured tempo allows hold-up horses to get into perfect striking position before unleashing superior finishing speed in the final furlong. Liverpool Star and Ellie's de Vega benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Cosmic Clarets or Simba's Pride press With Glory early
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates gaps for horses with tactical speed to exploit. Cosmic Clarets can capitalize if avoiding his usual fade pattern.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If With Glory goes too slow and field bunches dangerously
scenarios.body: The crawling pace creates a cavalry charge finish where any horse can win on the day regardless of ability. Breeze Star's low weight becomes crucial in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Special
scenarios.trigger: If With Glory finds perfect rhythm and opponents fail to respond
scenarios.body: The leader maintains comfortable fractions while covering runners' moves, staying clear in the final stages. With Glory's prominent style suits front-running tactics perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Cosmic Clarets must prove he can sustain his effort to the line without his usual fade in the final furlong
With Glory faces significant fitness test returning from 58-day break as the likely pacesetter throughout
Breeze Star returns from 198 days off carrying bottom weight which could prove decisive if retaining ability

races.paceDynamic: Digital and Until Dawn will contest the early lead, with Digital showing more reliable pace-setting credentials despite both horses lacking recent sharpness. Hi Lord and Ganesha should track just behind this duo, creating an honest gallop over the minimum trip. The large field of hold-up horses (Midnight Lir, Thunderstorm Katie, Mount Ruapehu, King Of The Jungle) will need the pace to collapse to be effective over 5f. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with early pace who can capitalise if the front two weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Collapse Early
scenarios.trigger: If Digital and Until Dawn both show their recent sluggishness and fade turning for home
scenarios.body: Hi Lord and Ganesha, tracking in the perfect striking positions, can sweep past the weakening leaders and hold off the back-markers who won't have enough time to close over 5f. This creates the ideal setup for prominent racers with a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Digital Finds Old Form
scenarios.trigger: If Digital recaptures the form that won over this C&D in January and sustains his gallop
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can dominate from the front with Ruth Carr's 4/34 strike-rate masking his ability when right. Until Dawn and Hi Lord will chase but Digital's proven course form gives him the edge in a battle of the early pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the front-runners tie up badly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Mount Ruapehu's recent winning form and Thunderstorm Katie's course-winning record could see them storm home late. However, 5f leaves little margin for error from the back, requiring perfect timing and gaps.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sixcor Shock Value
scenarios.trigger: If the 8-year-old's class tells despite the long absence and Ethan Tindall's claim proves crucial
scenarios.body: Sixcor's proven 5f form on good ground and significant weight advantage could surprise tired rivals. Linda Perratt's 1/7 record suggests selective placement, though the 202-day break remains a major concern.

watchPoints.text: Digital and Until Dawn both show early pace but question marks over sharpness could see them fold quickly if they go too fast early
Mount Ruapehu's winning form looks strong but hold-up runners face an almost impossible task over 5f unless pace collapses dramatically
Hi Lord drops back to 5f for the first time since April and this trip reduction could unlock improvement
Sixcor carries just 116lbs after a 202-day break and any market support would suggest connections expect a big run despite the layoff
Thunderstorm Katie won over C&D in May but the 103-day gap since her last run raises fitness questions in a competitive handicap

runners_data.name: Gozo

runners_data.name: Valley Of Flowers

runners_data.name: Newport

runners_data.name: Taylormade Lad

races.paceDynamic: Gozo will lead from the gates with no natural pace pressure, allowing him to dictate a steady rhythm through the early stages. Alpine Sierra, Taylormade Lad and Jaminoz will track in behind as the prominent group, while the hold-up contingent of Monsieur Melee, Valley Of Flowers, Newport and Ned Broy will settle towards the rear. With only one confirmed front-runner and a moderate pace likely, the tactical advantage swings decisively towards the closers who can unleash late runs down Hamilton's testing home straight. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can capitalise on the sustainable gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Gozo sets an uncontested lead and maintains steady fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the perfect setup to produce their finishing kicks down the straight. Valley Of Flowers and Monsieur Melee can time their challenges perfectly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from halfway as Alpine Sierra or Taylormade Lad apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race develops into a tactical battle where those handy to the pace can kick clear before the back-markers arrive. Alpine Sierra's recent form and light weight make her dangerous in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Gozo's class tells and he maintains his advantage despite challenges
scenarios.body: The leader's stamina reserves prove superior and he holds off all challengers to the line. His ability to dictate terms from the front becomes the winning factor.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test in the final two furlongs where ratings matter most. Taylormade Lad's higher top speed rating gives him the edge in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Gozo's fitness after 386 days off - any signs of blowing up in the home straight would open the race wide up
Valley Of Flowers' jumping from the gates - she needs to settle properly to execute her hold-up style effectively
Alpine Sierra's claimer Lauren Young taking 5lbs off - watch how confidently she tracks the early pace on the light weight
Taylormade Lad's fitness levels after 206 days - any laboured movement approaching the final furlong could end his chances
How Newport handles returning to turf after his break - his hold-up style needs confident riding to be effective
